Seeking Alpha is the premier website for actionable stock market opinion and analysis, and vibrant, intelligent finance discussion.  

Seeking Alpha provides a community of the nation's most savvy and inquisitive investors with tools to exchange and discuss investing ideas. Drawing from a contributor base of over 8000 investors, Seeking Alpha gives a voice to money managers, financial experts and investment analysts.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $26,522,249 to $36,203,716, a 1.37x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
